```{r plotType1Control}
plot.reject <- function(p.vals, main, ns) {
  alpha <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 100)
  type.1 <- matrix(NA, nrow = 100, ncol = ncol(p.vals))
  for(i in 1:100) {
    for(j in 1:ncol(p.vals)) {
      type.1[i,j] <- mean(p.vals[,j] < alpha[i], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  cols <- c("red", "blue", "green", "orange", "pink", "purple")
  plot(0, 0, type = "n", main = main, xlab = "Nominal Type-1 Error Level",
       ylab = "Rejection Probability", xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))
  for(j in 1:ncol(p.vals)) {
    lines(alpha, type.1[,j], lwd = 2, col = cols[j])
  }
  abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 3, lwd = 4)
}

m <- matrix(c(1,2,3,4),nrow = 2,ncol = 2,byrow = TRUE)
layout(mat = m,heights = c(0.3,0.3))
par(mar = c(4,4,2,1))

plot.reject(p.vals = p.vals.oracle[,,1], main = "Null (Oracle)", ns = ns)
plot.reject(p.vals = p.vals.adap[,,1], main = "Null (Adaptive)", ns = ns)
plot.reject(p.vals = p.vals.split[,,1], main = "Null (Split)", ns = ns)

plot.new()
cols <- c("red", "blue", "green", "orange", "pink", "purple")
legend("center", lty = rep(1, 4), lwd = rep(2, 4),
       legend = paste0("n = ", ns) , col = cols)
```

```{r IntervalSummary}

TestSummary <- function(alpha = .05, k, p.vals) {
  apply(p.vals[,,k], 2, function(x) mean(x < alpha, na.rm = TRUE))
}

ErrorSummary <- function(ests, k, true.iif) {
  E <- matrix(NA, nrow = dim(ests)[1], ncol = dim(ests)[2])
  for(i in 1:nrow(E)) {
    for(j in 1:ncol(E)) {
      E[i,j] <- (ests[i,j,k] - true.iif[k])^2
    }
  }
  out <- apply(E, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)^(1/2)
  return(out)
}

IntervalSummary <- function(ci.lower, ci.upper, k) {
  C <- matrix(NA, nrow = dim(ci.lower)[1], ncol = dim(ci.lower)[2])
  width <- matrix(NA, nrow = dim(ci.lower)[1], ncol = dim(ci.lower)[2])
  for(i in 1:nrow(C)) {
    for(j in 1:ncol(C)) {
      C[i,j] <- ifelse(true.iif[k] >= ci.lower[i,j,k] & 
                       true.iif[k] <= ci.upper[i,j,k],
                       1, 0)
      width[i,j] <- ci.upper[i,j,k] - ci.lower[i,j,k]
    }
  }
  out <- list(cover = C,
              coverage = apply(C, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
              width = width,
              avg.width = apply(width, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE))
  return(out)
}

PlotError <- function(error.mat, ns, main = "", ylim = c(0, 5)) {
  plot(x = c(1, length(ns)), y = c(0, 1), type = "n",
       ylim = ylim, xaxt = "n",
       xlab = "n", ylab = "RMSE", main = main)
  axis(side = 1, at = 1:length(ns), label = ns)

  lines(1:length(ns), error.mat[1,], lwd = .5, col = "red")
  lines(1:length(ns), error.mat[2,], lwd = .5, col = "blue")
  lines(1:length(ns), error.mat[3,], lwd = .5, col = "green")
  
  points(1:length(ns), error.mat[1,], bg = "red", pch = 21)
  points(1:length(ns), error.mat[2,], bg = "blue", pch = 21)
  points(1:length(ns), error.mat[3,], bg = "green", pch = 21)
}

PlotCoverage <- function(coverage.mat, ns, main = "") {
  plot(x = c(1, length(ns)), y = c(.5, 1), type = "n",
       ylim = c(.5, 1), xaxt = "n",
       xlab = "n", ylab = "Coverage", main = main)
  axis(side = 1, at = 1:length(ns), label = ns)
  abline(h = .95, col = "grey", lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)
  
  lines(1:length(ns), coverage.mat[1,], lwd = .5, col = "red")
  lines(1:length(ns), coverage.mat[2,], lwd = .5, col = "blue")
  lines(1:length(ns), coverage.mat[3,], lwd = .5, col = "green")
  
  points(1:length(ns), coverage.mat[1,], bg = "red", pch = 21)
  points(1:length(ns), coverage.mat[2,], bg = "blue", pch = 21)
  points(1:length(ns), coverage.mat[3,], bg = "green", pch = 21)
}

PlotWidth <- function(width.mat, ns, main = "", ylim = c(0, .5)) {
  plot(x = c(1, length(ns)), y = c(0, 1), type = "n",
       ylim = ylim, xaxt = "n",
       xlab = "n", ylab = "Width", main = main)
  axis(side = 1, at = 1:length(ns), label = ns)

  lines(1:length(ns), width.mat[1,], lwd = .5, col = "red")
  lines(1:length(ns), width.mat[2,], lwd = .5, col = "blue")
  lines(1:length(ns), width.mat[3,], lwd = .5, col = "green")
  
  points(1:length(ns), width.mat[1,], bg = "red", pch = 21)
  points(1:length(ns), width.mat[2,], bg = "blue", pch = 21)
  points(1:length(ns), width.mat[3,], bg = "green", pch = 21)
}

PlotTest <- function(test.mat, ns, main = "", ylim = c(0, .15), null = TRUE) {
  plot(x = c(1, length(ns)), y = c(0, 1), type = "n",
       ylim = ylim, xaxt = "n",
       xlab = "n", ylab = "Rejection Probability", main = main)
  axis(side = 1, at = 1:length(ns), label = ns)
  
  if(null) abline(h = .05, lwd = 2, lty = 2, col = "gray")

  lines(1:length(ns), test.mat[1,], lwd = .5, col = "red")
  lines(1:length(ns), test.mat[2,], lwd = .5, col = "blue")
  lines(1:length(ns), test.mat[3,], lwd = .5, col = "green")
  
  points(1:length(ns), test.mat[1,], bg = "red", pch = 21)
  points(1:length(ns), test.mat[2,], bg = "blue", pch = 21)
  points(1:length(ns), test.mat[3,], bg = "green", pch = 21)
}
```
